lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal blob rows to form a discernible grid-like pattern in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, yellow, vertically-striped fish (Gnathanodon speciosus) clustered near the pectoral fin and mid-lateral flank.
